description: This source file defines the GeneratedBatchContainer class, which implements the IBatchContainer interface for generated event payloads in Orleans streaming. It includes properties for stream identification, sequence tokens, enqueue time, and payload, along with constructor and method implementations.

classes.name: GeneratedBatchContainer
classes.description: Implementation of IBatchContainer for generated event payloads, providing properties for stream ID, sequence token, enqueue time, payload, and relevant methods.

methods.name: GeneratedBatchContainer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the container with a stream ID, payload, and token.

methods.name: GetEvents
methods.description: Returns an enumerable containing the event as a tuple of the payload cast to type T and the sequence token.

methods.name: ImportRequestContext
methods.description: Indicates whether the request context should be imported; always returns false in this implementation.
